blocker_taxonomy.zero_dependency_excluded: The binding gate needs an external artifact the zero-external-dependency constraint forbids. The artifact is named in the blocker text.
blocker_taxonomy.open_under_zero_dependency: No external artifact is required; the remaining work is a separate multi-module effort this program did not attempt.
blocker_taxonomy.no_go: A recorded ADR NO-GO decision; the lane is closed, not merely unstarted.

languages.blocker: Gates 4, 6, and 7 need an executing Pyrefly or Pyright provider, which is an external artifact this program excludes; the port now types every provider abstention but no provider answers. Gate 9 additionally needs a linked atomic audit, which no dependency blocks.

Gate 2 needs a translation-unit profile and a preprocessed frontend; a hand-written bounded scanner cannot be authoritative for C because the preprocessor decides what the tokens mean, so clang or an equivalent external frontend is required and excluded.

framework_support.why: C has a frontend, but every C/C++ backlog entry that passed the Wave F1 filter is a C++ framework. The C-native candidate, GLib/GObject G_DEFINE_TYPE, was assessed and deferred: its GNOME-style macro spelling has no proving test in this repository, so admitting it would rest on an unverified substrate. CppUnit's detector is reachable from the C language token because the frontend is shared, which is a property of that frontend and not a claim that C code uses CppUnit.

languages.blocker: Same as C, plus template instantiation and include resolution: no bounded in-process scanner can be the semantic oracle, and clang is excluded.
Gate 2 needs the effective Maven model and a resolved classpath before any symbol is package-qualified; javac or JDT is required and excluded. Tree-sitter structure alone cannot discharge it.

Gate 2 needs the MSBuild effective project and assembly resolution; Roslyn is required and excluded. A bounded .csproj NuGet manifest reader mirroring the .vbproj contract now exists at the parser layer, but discovery does not admit .csproj yet, so it yields no product-path inventory.

Corrected 2026-09-05, same finding as TypeScript: the claim that the TypeScript compiler worker ships with the package is false. Only workers/python/worker.py is bundled into the release archive. JavaScript shares the TS/JS lane, so its gate 2 has the same two routes: a bundled pinned TypeScript, which the zero-dependency constraint excludes, or a bounded hand-written frontend over a declared subset on the ADR-0042..0051 precedent, which it permits.

Gate 9 remains: the linked semantic prerequisite commits and the final completion audit. ADR-0043 D4b replaced the line scanner with a bounded recursive-descent parser over a declared VB.NET 10-17 invariance set, so malformed VB now abstains for the whole file and reports a degraded parse instead of yielding fewer admitted declarations. It needs no external artifact. Reclassified 2026-09-05: the class had stayed zero_dependency_excluded from before ADR-0043 landed the bounded parser, contradicting this row's own text and the taxonomy, under which a lane needing no external artifact is open_under_zero_dependency.

Gate 9 alone: the prerequisite chain is four independently coherent commits, but ADR-0020 G9 lists frontend/IR and UNKNOWN/provider as separate submodules and they landed together because for SQL they are inseparable -- a semantic UNKNOWN needs code-unit evidence, and no provider exists. Whether that satisfies G9 is a maintainer ruling, not a self-grant.

framework_support.why: SQL's framework surface is migration tooling, and both ADRs refuse to infer a migration tool or ordering from filenames. The bounded DDL frontend reads statement shapes only, and no other framework surface exists inside a .sql file.

languages.blocker: Gate 9 remains: the final completion audit with linked atomic prerequisite commits. Gate 4 closed with the R_OBLIGATION_REGISTRY in the testthat frontend: twelve claim-scoped typed UNKNOWNs covering identity (blocking), conditional reach, the description literal, the parse bounds, callee binding, block NSE, S3/S4 dispatch, and native/package symbols, each with a recorded provider fallback; no R semantic provider slot exists or is registered, so every residual is irreducible under current constraints.
Gate 4's recoverable type and trait obligations need rust-analyzer, which is excluded. Cargo project-model facts already exist; the remaining fixture, readiness, and audit gates need no dependency.

ADR-0044 now ships a hand-written bounded Object Pascal lexer and declaration parser over a declared subset, invariant across Delphi and Free Pascal in Delphi mode. Gate 9 is a maintainer ruling on G9's submodule structure.

ADR-0039 records a NO-GO: common .sb3 projects are deflated ZIP archives, and reading them needs a vetted deflate implementation the zero-dependency constraint excludes. A stored-entry JSON test is not evidence that ordinary archives work.

framework_support.why: Product integration is a recorded NO-GO over the deflate dependency, so no source is read and no framework family is reachable.

languages.blocker: Corrected 2026-09-05. The earlier text claimed "the TypeScript compiler worker already ships with the package"; it does not. The release workflow bundles only workers/python/worker.py into the archive, and the npm installer validates only that path, so src/workers/typescript/worker.js reaches no installed product. Even from a source checkout the worker's compiler-API mode is off unless a typescript package is resolvable: it tries require("typescript") first and only consults the analyzed repository's own copy when the operator sets REPOGRAMMAR_TSJS_TRUST_PROJECT_TYPESCRIPT=1, because loading it executes that repository's module code. With no compiler API every consumer guards on model.typescript and falls back to structural resolution, which ADR-0020 gate 2 forbids as a sole semantic oracle. Gate 2 therefore needs either a bundled and pinned TypeScript, which the zero-dependency constraint excludes, or a bounded hand-written frontend over a declared subset on the ADR-0042..0051 precedent, which the constraint permits and which no one has attempted.
